name: Kana Ichinose
bio: Kana Ichinose (市ノ瀬 加那, December 20) is a Japanese voice actress from Hokkaido. She is affiliated with Sigma Seven. She played her first main role in 2018 as Ichigo in the anime series Darling in the Franxx.
